purpose: Teach: フェルナンド/クルス/ヴェルディ/サダム/リヨン/スコープ/アグリ/ドーン

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、社会でスペインのフェルナンド王調べてたな
lines.en: Riku — you were researching King Ferdinand of Spain in social studies, weren't you?
lines.style: Playful accusation with a knowing smirk. Leans in slightly, eyes bright with caught-you energy. Quick pace, almost teasing. Testing to see how he'll respond.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、ペネロペ・クルスのファンだったろ、桜
lines.en: You're a Penélope Cruz fan though, aren't you, Sakura?
lines.style: Turns it back on her with a small, genuine smile. Calm, measured. No defensiveness — just turning the mirror around. Slight tilt of the head, amused.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、音楽でヴェルディのオペラ聴いてたな
lines.en: Riku — you were listening to Verdi opera in music class, weren't you?
lines.style: Continuing the game, eyes narrowed with amusement. Rhythmic, bouncing tone. Getting warmer to him — this is becoming a shared joke between them. Quick observations stacked like evidence.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、社会でサダム政権のニュース見たろ、桜
lines.en: You saw the news about Saddam's regime in social studies though, didn't you, Sakura?
lines.style: Matching her rhythm now. Calm, persistent. Almost rhythmic — there's a pattern forming and he's picked up on it. Slight warmth underneath, like he's enjoying this back-and-forth.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、社会でフランスのリヨンの場所調べてたな
lines.en: Riku — you were looking up where Lyon is in France for social studies, weren't you?
lines.style: Building momentum. Faster now, more confident. She's enjoying this — the rhythm of catching him noticing her noticing him. Slight laugh underneath the words.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、理科で望遠スコープ使ったろ、桜
lines.en: You used a telescope in science class though, didn't you, Sakura?
lines.style: Keeps pace with her energy now. No lag — he's been paying attention too. Quiet certainty beneath the words. Slight smile audible in the voice, like he's been waiting to use this.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、文化祭でアグリ、つまり農業体験ブースしてたな
lines.en: Riku — you were running an agriculture experience booth at the culture festival, weren't you?
lines.style: Pushing harder now, speaking faster. She's almost breathless with the game. Testing the limits of what he's noticed about her. Slight vulnerability creeping in under the teasing.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、ホラー映画「ドーン・オブ・ザ・デッド」観たろ、桜
lines.en: You watched that horror film 'Dawn of the Dead' though, didn't you, Sakura?
lines.style: Final counter-move. Delivered with quiet wryness — a slight smile. He's been saving this. Knows it'll land. Measured, almost gentle. The look in his voice says: I see you too.
